description:
Add an `otto init` CLI command that guides a new user through first-time setup interactively.

Flow:
1. Ask for GitHub personal access token (validate by calling GET /user, show the authenticated login on success)
2. Ask which runner to use: claude or codex (present as a choice; codex requires OPENAI_API_KEY)
3. For claude runner: confirm model (default claude-opus-4-7), offer to override
4. For codex runner: confirm API key env var name (default OPENAI_API_KEY)
5. Ask for the first repo to watch in owner/repo format (validate it exists and the token has access)
6. Write the config file to the default location (~/.otto/config.yaml or platform equivalent) — abort if a config already exists unless --force is passed
7. Print a summary of what was written and how to start the daemon (`otto start`)

The wizard should be non-interactive-friendly: all options can be passed as flags (`--token`, `--runner`, `--repo`, etc.) so it can be scripted. If all required flags are present, skip prompts entirely.
title: otto init — first-run setup wizard
